Method of Attack: Injects obfuscated JavaScript into ecommerce checkout or cart pages to steal credit card and address information entered by customers, sending it to a remote server controlled by attackers.
Impacted Systems: Atlanta Hawks online shop ecommerce site (hawksshop.com)
Attack Vector: Compromise of ecommerce site allowing injection of malicious JavaScript into checkout page
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious script making requests to remote site imagesengines[.]com
